text: Solicitation Issued: October 12, 2021 Solicitation Closed: November 30, 2021 Number of Addenda Issued: 4 Number of Bids: Thirty Three (33)

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Recommended Supplier: Darch Fire Inc.
